strips.title: A day with the NOCO GB40 — in real life

panels.head: Monday, 7 a.m.
panels.text: The car clicks and the dash goes dim. Vera fetches the NOCO from the glovebox instead of a neighbour.

panels.head: Two clamps, one button
panels.text: Red to positive, black to bare metal or negative, then press Power. The white Boost light means it is ready.

panels.head: The catch
panels.text: A red light means the clamps are reversed; a blinking one means it is hot. Leave a pause between tries.

panels.head: Afterwards
panels.text: The car starts, the clamps come off, and the NOCO goes on a USB charger so it is ready next winter.
